lifecycle_phases.description: WorkerBridgeComponent.TryInstallOperatorStartupConfig installs active parent receipt into _activeAdmissionReceipt and _activeStartupConfig.
invariants: Seals parent operator config monotonically.
If install fails, logs error and returns fail-closed without creating controller GameObject.

lifecycle_phases.description: WorkerBridgeComponent.SetPendingStartupHandoff binds GameObject owner, sets _staticPairModeRequired = true and _staticHandoffRegistrationSpent = true.
invariants: Atomic registration inside lock(_startupHandoffLock).
Rejects lifetime re-registration if _staticHandoffRegistrationSpent is already true.
Rejects live overwrite if _registeredHandoffOwner != null.
Verifies cohort equality against _activeAdmissionReceipt and _activeStartupConfig.
On failure, returns false; bootstrap destroys go and returns fail-closed without calling AddComponent.

lifecycle_phases.description: try { go.AddComponent<WorkerBridgeComponent>(); } catch (Exception ex) { CleanupEscapingAddComponentFailure(go); Destroy(go); return; }
invariants: Guards escaping component addition or synchronous Awake failures.
Calls CleanupEscapingAddComponentFailure(go) to mark _staticStartupAborted = true and clear _pendingPairPayload.
Destroys go and returns fail-closed.

lifecycle_phases.description: Awake entry retains managed GameObject reference in _retainedOwner, establishes _isPairRequiredMode if _staticPairModeRequired is true, and executes fail-closed early abort if acquisition fails.
invariants: _retainedOwner = this.gameObject safely stored before any operations.
If _staticPairModeRequired == true, instance _isPairRequiredMode is set to true immediately.
TryAcquirePendingStartupHandoff consumes _pendingPairPayload atomically on matching owner.
If _isPairRequiredMode is true and _privatePairProfile is null, logs error and returns immediately before fastEcology, log callbacks, policy, or listeners.

lifecycle_phases.description: Awake completion sets _startupInitializationComplete = true. Internal catch sets _startupInitializationComplete = false, _staticStartupAborted = true, cleans partially initialized resources, and calls CleanupOwnerPendingHandoff(_retainedOwner).
invariants: Successful initialization marks _startupInitializationComplete = true.
Any caught exception marks initialization incomplete and aborted.
Cleans partially initialized log callbacks, policy, and listener threads safely.
Calls CleanupOwnerPendingHandoff(_retainedOwner) to release pending payload.

lifecycle_phases.description: Update entry guard checks: if ((_isPairRequiredMode && (!_startupInitializationComplete || _privatePairProfile == null)) || _staticStartupAborted) return;
invariants: Blocks Update execution completely if required pair mode was uninitialized or aborted.
Placed immediately at entry of Update() before fastEcology suppression, tick processing, or domain actions.

lifecycle_phases.description: OnDestroy() invokes CleanupOwnerPendingHandoff(_retainedOwner) inside try/catch, preserving mode and spent flags, and cleans instance resources. LaunchChildValidatorTask holds M05 if _isPairRequiredMode || _staticPairModeRequired || _privatePairProfile != null || _staticStartupAborted.
invariants: Does not call unsafe this.gameObject property on destroyed native object during OnDestroy.
Cleans only matching owner payload.
Preserves _staticPairModeRequired and _staticHandoffRegistrationSpent flags.
Child launch returns ERROR: M05_NOT_ADMITTED unconditionally.

source_only_lifetime_scenarios.description: First SetPendingStartupHandoff by legitimate owner with matching cohort establishes _staticPairModeRequired = true, _staticHandoffRegistrationSpent = true, and populates _pendingPairPayload. Returns true.
TryAcquirePendingStartupHandoff when _pendingPairPayload == null returns false. If _staticPairModeRequired == true, _isPairRequiredMode remains true, Awake aborts fail-closed, and Update is blocked.
TryAcquirePendingStartupHandoff called from a different GameObject (!ReferenceEquals(_registeredHandoffOwner, this.gameObject)) returns false without clearing pending payload.
TryAcquirePendingStartupHandoff on a consumed slot (_pendingPairPayload == null) returns false. Registration spent flag _staticHandoffRegistrationSpent remains true; cannot re-register.
Repeated call to SetPendingStartupHandoff returns false because _staticHandoffRegistrationSpent is already true (lifetime one-registration guard).
If cohort verification fails during Set (e.g. parentReceipt != _activeAdmissionReceipt), returns false, does not set pair mode, caller destroys go.

If an exception occurs inside Awake, the internal catch tail sets _startupInitializationComplete = false, _staticStartupAborted = true, cleans partial resources, and calls CleanupOwnerPendingHandoff(_retainedOwner).
Even if profile is null or cleared, if _isPairRequiredMode || _staticPairModeRequired || _staticStartupAborted, child launch returns ERROR: M05_NOT_ADMITTED: Child launch execution withheld in R31.
In OnDestroy(), _retainedOwner (captured at Awake entry) is passed to CleanupOwnerPendingHandoff(_retainedOwner) rather than evaluating this.gameObject on a destroyed native peer.
Calling CleanupOwnerPendingHandoff with null or a different owner does not clear _pendingPairPayload. Calling OnDestroy multiple times safely handles null payload.
If _isPairRequiredMode and (!_startupInitializationComplete || _privatePairProfile == null) or _staticStartupAborted, Update() returns immediately before executing any simulation or clock work.

limitations: SOURCE_ONLY_BRANCH_REASONING: The above scenarios are static source-level verification only. Native Unity lifecycle, actual component destruction, and C# Process APIs were strictly unexecuted.
NATIVE_AWAKE_PROPAGATION_UNTESTED: Synchronous vs asynchronous Awake invocation and native exception propagation remain unobserved in this managed test environment.
